quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a crossroad is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road hazards. This sign warns of a steep downhill ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid accidents.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes of opposite traffic are merging.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has limited height clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (in this case, 13 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a yield sign. Slow down to check for traffic. Give the right-of-way to pedestrians and oncoming traffic. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road hazards. This sign warns that low clearance is ahead.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, it means:

options.text: The road to the right is one-way traffic only.
Detour to the right due to roadwork ahead.
Slow down. The road ahead curves sharply at an extreme angle.
A crossroad is to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down. The road ahead curves sharply at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead has a sharp curve at an extreme angle in this direction. Slow down as much as you would when turning at an intersection.

questions.question: This sign indicates that:

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on the hill ahead.
Trucks are on the hill ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells drivers what they must or must not do. Where this sign is posted, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?

options.text: The maximum safe speed in a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed in a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This advisory speed sign shows the maximum safe speed for a highway exit. In this example, the safe exit speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Drivers can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it means the driver plans to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge onto the road from the right.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even without a stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must give way to pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk. Stay alert for pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Be ready for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These spaces are for people with disability permits only.
Traffic must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are for buses and carpools.

questions.correctAnswerText: These spaces are for people with disability permits only.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disability permits.

questions.question: This sign prevents:

options.text: Wrong-way traffic on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wrong-way traffic on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is one-way and you cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show rules you must obey. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards and road conditions. This sign warns of an intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a pedestrian crossing is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop for people crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign means the divided highway is ending soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and get ready to stop.
Stop completely, then go only if it is safe.
Go through carefully, but you may not need to stop.
Stop only if traffic is coming from another road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go only if it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always make a complete stop. Only go forward when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A worker is ahead directing traffic.

questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
When turning left on green, yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning left on green, yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign used with a traffic light tells drivers that left-turning traffic must wait and let oncoming traffic pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people in the crosswalk. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that bicycles may cross here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reduce your speed when the road is wet.
The road ahead has curves and turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, do not brake or turn suddenly, and increase your distance from the vehicle ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The right lane will end soon.
A highway entrance ramp is ahead.
The left lane will end soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane will end soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn right or go straight.
You can turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you must either turn right or continue straight ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves only to the right.
The road turns sharply to the right.
The road curves right, then curves left.
The road curves left, then curves right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then curves left.
questions.explanation: This warning sign is yellow with black markings. It tells you the road ahead will curve to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are coming.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride alongside traffic. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles are common here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange sign warns you of construction or maintenance work ahead. Slow down and drive carefully through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that the road curves ahead. Be ready to slow down.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down and always let trains cross first. Trains cannot stop for you, so you must yield to them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road becomes slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is especially slippery when it is wet. Drive slowly and carefully.

questions.question: What does a posted speed limit sign show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed under all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit. When conditions are bad, you should slow down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: From bottom to top, what is the order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: From bottom to top, traffic lights are ordered: green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is starting. The road splits into two separate one-way paths with a median between them. Stay on the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. In this case, right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and make sure all vehicles and pedestrians are clear before you move.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means that right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road ahead has many curves. Slow down as needed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow to the speed shown.
A divided highway starts. Slow to the speed shown.
Traffic is merging. Slow to the speed shown.
A winding road is ahead. Slow to the speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow to the speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right ahead. You should slow down to the safe speed shown (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells drivers that traffic may come from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails are ahead and to the right.
A hotel is ahead and to the right.
A hospital is ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A hospital is ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that hospital emergency services are located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A bicycle repair shop is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop completely before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: A yellow and black diamond-shaped sign:

options.text: Warns about road and traffic conditions ahead.
Directs you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and rules.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns about road and traffic conditions ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black symbols. They warn drivers about conditions on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
Your road meets a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road meets a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road is about to cross a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
Stop completely and go when it is safe.
Go through carefully without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on the side road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must stop completely and let vehicles and pedestrians in or near the intersection go first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A person with a flag is ahead to direct traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A person with a flag is ahead to direct traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign means a flagger is ahead. A flagger is a person who directs traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep slope. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does it mean when a rider extends their left arm straight out to the left?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals instead of mechanical turn signals. When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the left, it means they plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions. This sign is yellow with black markings. It warns that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to allow traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or very close to the road ahead. Drive with extra care through this area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has several turns and curves.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and points their index finger?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in a group. When the lead rider raises their left arm and points their index finger, the group should move into a single-file line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead is now divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane ends ahead. Traffic in the right lane must move left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns of a school zone ahead. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply right and then left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a merge ahead. Two lanes of traffic will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of turn signals. When your left arm is extended straight out to the left, it means you plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that when turning left at a green light, they must yield to oncoming traffic and only turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will curve right and then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on the upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts drivers that an upcoming bridge may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians pass. You must stop if traffic conditions require it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in that direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that there is a sharp turn ahead and you should slow down.

questions.question: What is this warning sign telling you?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow and black. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a stop sign is ahead. Get ready to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
There is a traffic light ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic light ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic light is at the intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down when approaching an intersection. Be ready to stop and let other drivers or pedestrians go first. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what must you do?

options.text: You can either continue on the freeway or exit from your current lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue on the freeway.
You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will leave the freeway. Your lane will not continue through the interchange. You can either change lanes to stay on the freeway or stay in your lane and exit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at this exact speed.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest speed you may drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead will curve sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow and black. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that a lane is ending. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. It means parking is not allowed here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an intersection ahead. A road will join from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow backgrounds. They alert you to dangers ahead. This sign warns you that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. A traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. These lanes are only for buses and cars with the driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and let others go first at an intersection. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and then swings it down to their side, other riders should slow down.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals to show turns or stops instead of or with mechanical turn signals. When a rider bends their left arm at the elbow and points it upward, it means they plan to turn right or move right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns you to drive carefully when the road is wet.

questions.question: What does it mean when an operator's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward?

options.text: The operator plans to turn left.
The operator is about to stop.
The operator plans to turn right.
The operator is about to slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: The operator plans to turn right.
questions.explanation: Hand signals show turns and stops when turn signals are not available. When an operator bends their left arm at the elbow and points upward, it means they plan to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. Drivers must obey these signs. This sign means passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill grade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a winding road with three or more curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to a traffic signal coming up. Be ready for red lights, yellow lights, and crossing traffic.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your current speed.
Speed up to avoid creating congestion.
Change lanes safely to make room for incoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes safely to make room for incoming traffic.
questions.explanation: On a road with two or more lanes, make room for traffic entering from the side. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let traffic in.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of colors on a traffic light?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic light, red is always on top and green is always on bottom. On a horizontal traffic light, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right when you see this sign at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you drive past this sign, you are going the wrong way and risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or for driving straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means that action is not allowed. U-turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is ahead. Enter it slowly and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: In group riding, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, all riders should stop.

questions.question: What should you be most concerned about when you see this sign?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is always a stop sign. You must stop completely and look for pedestrians and other traffic. Wait for the intersection to clear before going.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This chevron sign shows the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. Multiple signs may be placed throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black symbols. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Slow down and be ready to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm up, then swings the arm upward, it means riders should go faster.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you must stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means you cannot do that action. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign warns of what?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: This sign warns of what?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T-shaped intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black symbols. They alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Drive slowly and carefully because your vehicle may be hard to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.
